event.description: Use independent 7-dimensional QKV projections within each of two attention heads while retaining each block's dense 14x14 attention-output projection, d=14, two blocks, ff=20, and rank-8 learned positions.
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0006, d=14 with two heads (3528, 99.66%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0008, a one-layer d=14 variant that was an optimization failure; 3 prior family macro-attempts. The immediately preceding attempt-0018 fixed-position training-control retry is an optimization failure (45000 steps, no checkpoint), so its unscored result does not establish a verifier boundary. Hypothesis: per-head QKV computation may be sufficient because the retained dense output projection and feed-forward networks still mix the two head subspaces after attention; restricting only QKV maps removes 294 weights per block, reducing 3430 to 2842 actual parameters without reducing d_model, head count, or depth. This is an attention-organization representational change, not scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested d=12 alternative because it preserves the established d=14 residual capacity while directly testing whether cross-head QKV coupling is necessary.
